title: service manifest
description: Everything okibi is allowed to know about a service. See spec/okibi-contract.md.

url_template.description: Substituting {tileset}, {id} and {epoch.*} must reconstruct a URL that regenerates the tile.

meta_urls.description: Keyed by tile kind, for the documents that have no coordinates. A null says the kind is asked for and warming it would achieve nothing — a document composed per request, or one whose freshness is measured in a minute. A kind that is absent is a URL somebody forgot, and is refused rather than guessed at.

default_gen_ms.description: Used only for cells the digest has no measurement for.

billing.description: Resource counts per generation. Never prices: those live in a pricing table.

per_gen.description: How much of each resource one generation spends, keyed the way the pricing table keys its units. null means measure it: cpu_ms falls back to the digest's p50_gen_ms and egress_byte to its avg_bytes; any other resource left null counts as nothing.

warm_above_gen_ms.description: Below this measured generation time, do not warm at all. Not the same as ranking low: a plan already orders by demand times cost, so a fast tile sorts to the back and a bigger budget would still reach it. This says it should not. Applies to measurements only — a cell carrying the fallback is unmeasured, not fast.

interactive_priority.description: The origin keeps real misses ahead of warming.

zoom_semantics.description: Whether a shallower zoom is a coarser view of the same ground, which decides whether ancestors are worth warming.
